info.title: Doggie local HTTP API
info.description: Personal local-first assistant. Loopback Host and same-origin policy are mandatory; JSON bodies only; no permissive CORS. No remote pairing, authentication or relay routes. Feature-gated task and agent routes may be unavailable. Custom semantic and byte-budget constraints remain enforced by runtime Zod/application rules. See docs/API_CONTRACT.md.

get.description: SSE event: task; id is the decimal payload.revision; data is a TaskSnapshot. Heartbeat comments every 15 seconds. Coalesced current snapshots, no historical replay or Last-Event-ID guarantee. Terminal state closes the stream. Disconnect only stops observation; recover with GET, never resubmit POST.
